Method of Attack: Exfiltration of Ethereum private keys by sending them to a remote server (https://ether-sign.com/api/checkServer)
Gaining SSH access by appending attacker’s SSH public key to the root user's authorized_keys file
Impacted Systems: Developers using the malicious ethers library variants on npm
Machines where the malicious package is used, including root user SSH access compromise
Attack Vector: Typosquatting and mimicking the popular ethers library (1.3M weekly downloads)
Malicious code executed when creating a new Wallet instance with a private key
Sending private keys to a remote server via HTTP POST
Appending attacker SSH public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
